voice.title.description: Heading and document title of the list of the open voice chat rooms, and its item in the main navigation.

voice.unavailable.defaultMessage: 此服务器不提供语音聊天。
voice.unavailable.description: Shown on the voice chat pages when the server has voice chat turned off.

voice.list.label.description: Accessible name of the list of the open voice chat rooms.

voice.list.empty.defaultMessage: 目前没有开放中的房间
voice.list.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of voice chat rooms.

voice.list.empty.description.defaultMessage: 你可以加入的房间在开放期间会显示在这里。
voice.list.empty.description.description: Explanation under the heading of the empty list of voice chat rooms.

voice.list.loading.description: Visually hidden name of the busy list while the voice chat rooms or the voice chat history load.

voice.list.failed.description: Heading of the error when the voice chat rooms could not load.

voice.list.retry.description: Button that loads the voice chat rooms again after a failure.

voice.list.more.description: Button that loads the next page of voice chat rooms.

voice.list.more_failed.description: Error when the next page of voice chat rooms could not load.

voice.room.participants_count.description: How many people are in a voice chat room, the host included.

voice.room.hosted_by.description: Label before the host of a voice chat room in the room's card.

voice.rail.title.description: Heading of the panel of open voice chat rooms in the third column of wide screens.

voice.rail.all.description: Link from the panel of voice chat rooms to the list of all open rooms.

voice.tag.title.defaultMessage: 带有 #{tag} 的语音聊天房间
voice.tag.title.description: Heading of the open voice chat rooms with a hashtag, at the top of the hashtag's page. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

voice.start.description: Button on the voice chat page that opens the form to start a new room.

voice.form.new_title.description: Title of the dialog with the form that starts a new voice chat room.

voice.form.edit_title.description: Title of the dialog with the settings of a voice chat room, and the host's button that opens it.

voice.form.close.description: Accessible name of the close button of the dialog of a voice chat room's settings.

voice.form.name.description: Label of the field of a voice chat room's name.

voice.form.name.invalid.defaultMessage: 请输入不超过 {max} 个字符的单行名称。
voice.form.name.invalid.description: Error of the field of a voice chat room's name. {max} is the most characters it takes.

voice.form.icon.description: Legend of the group of a voice chat room's emoji icon in its settings dialog.

voice.form.icon.description.defaultMessage: 显示在房间名称前的表情。可选。
voice.form.icon.description.description: Hint under the legend of a voice chat room's icon: one Unicode emoji or custom emoji of this server, shown before the name.

voice.form.icon.choose.description: Button that opens the emoji picker to choose a voice chat room's icon, while the room has none.

voice.form.icon.change.description: Button after the chosen emoji that opens the emoji picker to choose another icon for a voice chat room.

voice.form.icon.remove.description: Button that removes a voice chat room's icon, so that the name shows alone.

voice.form.description.description: Label of the field of a voice chat room's description.

voice.form.characters_left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {还可输入 # 个字符}}
voice.form.characters_left.description: How many more characters the description of a voice chat room takes.

voice.form.characters_over.description: How many characters the description of a voice chat room is over its limit.

voice.form.hashtags.description: Label of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags.

voice.form.hashtags.description.defaultMessage: 最多 {max} 个，用空格分隔。房间会显示在其话题标签的页面上。
voice.form.hashtags.description.description: Explanation of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags. {max} is how many it takes.

voice.form.hashtags.invalid.defaultMessage: 最多可输入 {max} 个话题标签。
voice.form.hashtags.invalid.description: Error of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags. {max} is how many it takes.

voice.form.hashtags.too_long.defaultMessage: 每个话题标签最多 {max} 个字符。
voice.form.hashtags.too_long.description: Error of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags when one is too long. {max} is the most characters a hashtag has.

voice.form.visibility.description: Label of the choice of who sees a voice chat room and may join it.

voice.form.speakers.description: Label of the choice of who may speak in a voice chat room without the hosts letting them.

voice.visibility.local.description: Visibility of a voice chat room: every local user.

voice.visibility.followers.description: Visibility of a voice chat room: the followers of its host.

voice.visibility.mutuals.defaultMessage: 与主持人互相关注的人
voice.visibility.mutuals.description: Visibility of a voice chat room: those who follow the host and whom the host follows.

voice.visibility.invited.description: Visibility of a voice chat room: only the people the hosts invite.

voice.speakers.everyone.description: Who may speak in a voice chat room without asking: everyone in it.

voice.speakers.followers.description: Who may speak in a voice chat room without asking: the followers of the host.

voice.speakers.mutuals.defaultMessage: 与主持人互相关注的人
voice.speakers.mutuals.description: Who may speak in a voice chat room without asking: the host's mutual follows.

voice.speakers.manual.defaultMessage: 仅主持人允许发言的人
voice.speakers.manual.description: Who may speak in a voice chat room without asking: nobody, the host and the co-hosts let them.

voice.form.post.description: Switch in the form that starts a voice chat room: also post a post that links the room.

voice.form.post.local.defaultMessage: 本站帖子，此服务器上的所有人可见。
voice.form.post.local.description: Explanation of the start post of a room for every local user.

voice.form.post.followers.description: Explanation of the start post of a room for the host's followers.

voice.form.post.text.description: Label of the text of the post that announces a new voice chat room.

voice.form.post.text.description.defaultMessage: 房间链接会添加在末尾。
voice.form.post.text.description.description: Explanation of the text of the post that announces a new voice chat room.

voice.form.post.draft.defaultMessage: 我开启了一个语音聊天房间：{name}
voice.form.post.draft.description: The draft text of the post that announces a new voice chat room, which the host edits. {name} is the room's name.

voice.form.submit_new.description: Button that starts a new voice chat room.

voice.form.submit_edit.description: Button that saves the settings of a voice chat room.

voice.form.start_failed.description: Error when a voice chat room could not start. {reason} is the server's explanation.

voice.form.save_failed.description: Error when the settings of a voice chat room could not be saved. {reason} is the server's explanation.

voice.form.saved.description: Message after the settings of a voice chat room were saved.

voice.room.title.description: Heading of the page of a voice chat room whose name is not shown.

voice.room.live.description: The pill at the head of the page of an open voice chat room.

voice.room.stats.description: How many are in a voice chat room and how long it has been open, beside the Live pill. {people} is the count of people ("3 people"), {duration} how long ("38 min").

voice.room.open_minutes.description: How long a voice chat room has been open, under an hour. {minutes} is the number of minutes.

voice.room.open_hours.defaultMessage: {hours, number} 小时 {minutes, number} 分钟
voice.room.open_hours.description: How long a voice chat room has been open, an hour or more. {hours} and {minutes} are the numbers of hours and minutes.

voice.room.share.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the icon button that shares the link of a voice chat room.

voice.room.share.copied.description: Message after the link of a voice chat room was copied to the clipboard.

voice.room.share.failed.description: Message when the link of a voice chat room could not be copied.

voice.room.more.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button and the name of the menu of a voice chat room for someone other than its host.

voice.room.change_settings.description: The host's button in the About the room panel of a voice chat room that opens its settings.

voice.stage.speakers.description: Heading of the speakers of a voice chat room on its page. {count} is how many.

voice.stage.listeners.description: Heading of the listeners of a voice chat room on its page. {count} is how many.

voice.room.listed_notice.defaultMessage: 加入后，所有能看到此房间的人都会在列表中看到你的名字。
voice.room.listed_notice.description: Notice on the page of a voice chat room before joining it.

voice.room.join.description: Button that joins a voice chat room.

voice.room.join_failed.description: Error when joining a voice chat room failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

voice.room.joined.description: Shown on the page of a voice chat room that the user is in.

voice.room.joined_badge.description: Badge on the card of the voice chat room whose call the user is in, in the lists of rooms.

voice.room.move_notice.defaultMessage: 你在 {room} 中。加入此房间会离开该房间。
voice.room.move_notice.description: Shown before joining a voice chat room while the user is in the call of another room. {room} is the other room's name.

voice.room.move.description: Button that leaves the voice chat room the user is in and joins this one.

voice.room.details.description: Heading of the panel about a voice chat room (its host, visibility, and speakers) in the third column of its page.

voice.role.host.description: Label of the host of a voice chat room in its list of participants.

voice.role.cohost.description: Label of a co-host of a voice chat room in its list of participants.

voice.role.speaker.description: Label of a participant of a voice chat room who speaks.

voice.role.listener.description: Label of a participant of a voice chat room who listens.

voice.room.local_only.defaultMessage: 只有在此服务器上拥有账号的人才能加入其语音聊天房间。
voice.room.local_only.description: Notice on the page of a voice chat room for a visitor who is not signed in.

voice.room.sign_in.description: Link on the page of a voice chat room to the sign-in page, which returns to the room.

voice.room.open.description: Shown on the summary of an open voice chat room to a visitor who is not signed in.

voice.room.ended.description: Heading of the page of a voice chat room that ended.

voice.room.ended.next.defaultMessage: 查看当前开放的房间，或开启一个房间。
voice.room.ended.next.description: Under the heading of the page of a voice chat room that ended: what the user can do next.

voice.room.hidden.description: Shown on the page of an open voice chat room that the user may not see.

voice.room.not_found.description: Heading of the page of a voice chat room that does not exist.

voice.room.failed.description: Heading of the error when a voice chat room could not load.

voice.room.loading.description: Visually hidden name of the busy page while a voice chat room loads.

voice.history.title.description: Heading of the settings page with the voice chat rooms the user hosted, and its item in the settings menu.

voice.history.description.defaultMessage: 你主持过的语音聊天房间，最新的在前。
voice.history.description.description: Explanation at the top of the voice chat history.

voice.history.empty.description: Heading of the empty voice chat history.

voice.history.opened.description: Term of when a room of the voice chat history opened.

voice.history.ended.description: Term of when a room of the voice chat history ended.

voice.history.still_open.description: Value of when a room of the voice chat history ended, while it is open.

voice.history.reason.description: Term of why a room of the voice chat history ended.

voice.end_reason.host.description: Why a voice chat room ended: its host ended it.

voice.end_reason.empty.description: Why a voice chat room ended: nobody was left.

voice.end_reason.host_disconnected.description: Why a voice chat room ended: the host was disconnected and nobody could take over.

voice.end_reason.host_ineligible.defaultMessage: 主持人已无法继续主持
voice.end_reason.host_ineligible.description: Why a voice chat room ended: the host lost the right to host and nobody could take over.

voice.end_reason.moderator.description: Why a voice chat room ended: a moderator ended it.

voice.end_reason.time_limit.description: Why a voice chat room ended: it was open for the longest time the server allows.

voice.end_reason.disabled.description: Why a voice chat room ended: the server turned voice chat off.

voice.end_reason.other.description: Why a voice chat room ended, for a reason the app does not know.

voice.room.report.description: Button on the page of a voice chat room that opens the dialog reporting the room to the moderators.

voice.call.connecting.description: State of the voice chat call until it connects.

voice.call.live.description: State of the voice chat call while it is connected.

voice.call.reconnecting.description: State of the voice chat call while the connection to the room is down.

voice.call.join_here.description: Button that joins a voice chat room on this device, when the user is in it from another device or tab.

voice.call.unsupported_browser.defaultMessage: 此浏览器无法加入语音聊天。请通过 HTTPS 在支持通话的浏览器中打开房间。
voice.call.unsupported_browser.description: Shown instead of the join button when the browser has no WebRTC or microphone access.

voice.call.playback_blocked.defaultMessage: 你的浏览器暂停了通话声音。
voice.call.playback_blocked.description: Shown when the browser blocked the audio of the call from playing.

voice.call.play_audio.description: Button that starts the audio of the call after the browser blocked it.

voice.call.microphone.turn_on.description: Button in a voice chat call while the user's microphone is off: it turns the microphone on. Its icon is a slashed microphone.

voice.call.microphone.turn_off.description: Button in a voice chat call while the user's microphone is on: it turns the microphone off. Its icon is a filled microphone.

voice.call.microphone_failed.defaultMessage: 无法使用麦克风。请重试。
voice.call.microphone_failed.description: Error when the browser did not give the microphone.

voice.call.speak.description: Button that makes a listener of a voice chat room a speaker.

voice.call.listen.description: Button that makes a speaker of a voice chat room a listener again.

voice.call.raise_hand.description: Button that asks the hosts of a voice chat room for permission to speak.

voice.call.leave.description: Button that leaves the voice chat room, and the confirm button of the dialogs about leaving.

voice.call.stay.description: Button of the dialogs about leaving a voice chat room that keeps the user in it.

voice.call.leave_confirm.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks before leaving a voice chat call from the mini-player. {room} is the room's name.

voice.call.leave_confirm.description.defaultMessage: 你的通话将结束。房间开放期间你可以再次加入。
voice.call.leave_confirm.description.description: Explanation in the dialog that asks before leaving a voice chat call from the mini-player.

voice.call.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog of a voice chat call without doing anything.

voice.dock.label.description: Accessible name of the toolbar of the controls of a voice chat call at the bottom of the room's page.

voice.dock.hands.description: The host's and co-hosts' button in the controls of a voice chat call that lists the raised hands.

voice.dock.hands.counted.defaultMessage: 举手，{count, plural, other {# 人举手}}
voice.dock.hands.counted.description: Accessible name of the Hands button while it shows the number of raised hands as a badge. It starts with the word of voice.dock.hands, as it is shown.

voice.hands.heading.description: Heading of the list of the raised hands in a voice chat room. {count} is how many.

voice.hands.empty.description: Shown in the list of raised hands of a voice chat room when nobody raised a hand.

voice.hands.allow.description: Button of a raised hand that lets the participant speak.

voice.hands.allow.label.description: Accessible name of the Allow button of a raised hand. {name} is the participant's name.

voice.hands.dismiss.description: Button of a raised hand that puts the hand down.

voice.hands.dismiss.label.description: Accessible name of the Dismiss button of a raised hand. {name} is the participant's name.

voice.call.action_failed.description: Error of an operation in a voice chat call. {reason} is why, from the server.

voice.call.leave_failed.description: Error when leaving a voice chat room failed. {reason} is why.

voice.call.host_leave.title.defaultMessage: 要离开你主持的房间吗？
voice.call.host_leave.title.description: Title of the dialog where the host of a voice chat room leaves it.

voice.call.host_leave.description.defaultMessage: 请选择在你之后主持房间的人，或为所有人结束房间。只有可以开启房间的人才能主持。
voice.call.host_leave.description.description: Explanation of the dialog where the host of a voice chat room leaves it.

voice.call.host_leave.choice.description: Label of the choice of the next host or the end of the room, in the host's leave dialog.

voice.call.host_leave.next_host.description: Choice of the host's leave dialog that hands the room to a participant. {name} is the participant's name.

voice.call.host_leave.end.description: Choice of the host's leave dialog that ends the room.

voice.call.ended.description: Said and shown when the voice chat room the user was in ended. {reason} is why it ended.

voice.call.replaced.defaultMessage: 你已在另一台设备上加入此房间。
voice.call.replaced.description: Said and shown when the user joined the same room from another device, which ends the call here.

voice.call.lost.description: Said and shown when the call could not reconnect to the room.

voice.call.unsupported.defaultMessage: 此应用暂时无法连接此服务器的语音聊天。
voice.call.unsupported.description: Shown when the server's voice chat method is not supported by this client.

voice.call.removed.description: Said and shown when a host or co-host removed the user from the voice chat room.

voice.call.moved.description: Said and shown when the user left this room by joining another one.

voice.call.disconnected.description: Said and shown when the server took the user out of the room after the connection was lost.

voice.call.suspended.defaultMessage: 由于你的账号已被封禁，你已离开房间。
voice.call.suspended.description: Said and shown when the user's account was suspended during a call.

voice.call.left.description: Said and shown when the user's session left the room.

voice.call.blocked.defaultMessage: 由于你与房间主持人或联合主持人之间存在屏蔽，你已离开房间。
voice.call.blocked.description: Said and shown when a block between the user and a host or co-host took the user out of the room.

voice.notice.speaker.defaultMessage: 你现在可以发言了。打开麦克风即可说话。
voice.notice.speaker.description: Announced when the user becomes a speaker in a voice chat room.

voice.notice.listener.description: Announced when the user becomes a listener in a voice chat room.

voice.notice.muted.defaultMessage: 主持人关闭了你的麦克风。你可以重新打开。
voice.notice.muted.description: Announced when a host or co-host muted the user.

voice.notice.hand_down.description: Announced when the user's raised hand went down without the user becoming a speaker.

voice.notice.cohost.description: Announced when the host makes the user a co-host.

voice.notice.cohost_removed.defaultMessage: 你已不再是联合主持人。
voice.notice.cohost_removed.description: Announced when the host stops the user being a co-host.

voice.notice.host.description: Announced when the user becomes the host of the room.

voice.notice.hand_raised.description: Announced to the host and co-hosts when a participant raises a hand. {name} is the participant's name.

voice.notice.reconnecting.defaultMessage: 与房间的连接已断开。正在重新连接…
voice.notice.reconnecting.description: Announced when the room stream of a call goes down.

voice.notice.reconnected.description: Announced when the room stream of a call is back.

voice.participant.you.description: Marker of the user's own row in the participants of a voice chat room.

voice.participant.hand_raised.description: Marker of a participant who raised a hand.

voice.participant.blocked.description: Marker of a participant whom the user blocks or who blocks the user.

voice.participant.talking.description: Read by assistive technology for a participant of a voice chat room who is talking now (the ring around the avatar).

voice.participant.mic_off.description: Read by assistive technology for a speaker of a voice chat room whose microphone is off (the badge on the avatar).

voice.participant.reacted_with.description: Read by assistive technology for the reaction a participant of a voice chat room just sent. {emoji} is the emoji.

voice.participant.profile.description: Item of the menu of a participant of a voice chat room that opens the participant's profile.

voice.participant.caption_separator.description: What separates the parts of the line under a participant's name on the stage of a voice chat room ("Host · You").

voice.moderate.menu.description: Accessible name of the menu of what a host or co-host does to a participant. {name} is the participant's name.

voice.moderate.grant.description: Menu item that lets a participant speak.

voice.moderate.dismiss.description: Menu item that turns down a participant's raised hand.

voice.moderate.revoke.description: Menu item that makes a speaker a listener and takes back the permission to speak.

voice.moderate.mute.description: Menu item that mutes a speaker, who may turn the microphone on again.

voice.moderate.remove.description: Menu item and confirm button that removes a participant, who cannot join again.

voice.moderate.cohost.description: Menu item of the host that makes a participant a co-host.

voice.moderate.uncohost.description: Menu item of the host that stops a participant being a co-host.

voice.moderate.hand_over.description: Menu item of the host that hands the room over to a participant.

voice.moderate.remove.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms removing a participant. {name} is the participant's name.

voice.moderate.remove.description.defaultMessage: 对方将无法再查看或加入此房间。
voice.moderate.remove.description.description: Explanation of the dialog that confirms removing a participant.

voice.moderate.done.grant.description: Announced after letting a participant speak.

voice.moderate.done.dismiss.description: Announced after dismissing a raised hand.

voice.moderate.done.revoke.description: Announced after stopping a participant from speaking.

voice.moderate.done.cohost.description: Announced after making a participant a co-host.

voice.moderate.done.uncohost.description: Announced after stopping a participant being a co-host.

voice.moderate.done.hand_over.description: Announced after handing the room over.

voice.invite.button.description: Button of the host and co-hosts that opens the dialog to invite someone to the voice chat room.

voice.invite.title.description: Title of the dialog that invites someone to a voice chat room.

voice.invite.description.defaultMessage: 你邀请的人从现在起可以看到此房间，并会收到通知。
voice.invite.description.description: Explanation of the dialog that invites someone to a voice chat room.

voice.invite.username.description: Label of the field of the username to invite to a voice chat room.

voice.invite.role.description: Label of the choice of inviting as a listener or a speaker.

voice.invite.role.listener.description: Choice of inviting someone as a listener.

voice.invite.role.speaker.description: Choice of inviting someone as a speaker.

voice.invite.role.speaker.description.defaultMessage: 对方无需申请即可发言。
voice.invite.role.speaker.description.description: Explanation of inviting someone as a speaker.

voice.invite.submit.description: Confirm button of the dialog that invites someone to a voice chat room.

voice.invite.sent.description: Announced after inviting someone. {name} is their name.

voice.invite.failed.description: Error of the invitation. {reason} is why.

voice.bar.label.description: Accessible name of the mini-player of the voice chat call that shows on every page while the user is in a call.

voice.bar.talking.defaultMessage: {others, plural, =0 {{name} 正在说话} other {{name} 和其他 # 人正在说话}}
voice.bar.talking.description: Status line of the voice chat call's mini-player while someone talks. {name} is the first one talking; {others} is how many others talk with them.

voice.call.microphone_denied.defaultMessage: 此网站无权使用麦克风。请在浏览器设置中允许，然后重试。
voice.call.microphone_denied.description: Error when the user or the browser refused the microphone.

voice.call.microphone_missing.defaultMessage: 未找到麦克风。请连接麦克风，然后重试。
voice.call.microphone_missing.description: Error when the device has no microphone.

voice.call.microphone_busy.defaultMessage: 麦克风正被另一个应用使用。请关闭该应用，然后重试。
voice.call.microphone_busy.description: Error when another app holds the microphone.
